SIX-BOX from BEST (iter-8 img_kernel=9 hr=0.2771): (1) PRIOR: IMAGE-DOMAIN fully explored -- img_n_bf sat@6, img_sr peak=0.05, img_kernel 5->9 (+0.0019, best 0.2771), epochs inert. The PROJECTION-DOMAIN Manduca denoiser (proj_n_bf=1, proj_sr=1.5, bf_d_w_ratio=1/6) is UNTOUCHED -- the solver's namesake core. (2) FAILURE MODE: the single proj-domain bilateral (proj_n_bf=1) is one shallow noise-modeled smoothing pass on the sqrt-count sinogram; too weak to suppress the sinogram inconsistencies that generate streaks after FBP. The image tail cleans post-FBP residual but cannot undo streak structure already baked into backprojection. (3) ONE KNOB: proj_n_bf 1 -> 3 (deepen the projection-domain Manduca bilateral cascade; from iter-8 best; params 21->27). Architecturally-distinct config family from the 8 image-domain-focused iters. (4) HYPOTHESIS: proj_n_bf 1->3 lifts hr above 0.2771 because a deeper noise-modeled bilateral cascade on the sqrt-count sinogram suppresses more signal-dependent sinogram noise BEFORE backprojection, reducing streak inconsistencies the post-FBP tail only partially cleans. FALSIFIER: if hr flat (as on Mayo), proj-domain is cosmetic on breast too -> iter-10 tunes proj_sr or consolidates. (5) BUDGET: +2 proj bilateral passes; ep10 base ~236-500s -> est ~450s, under 20-min. (6) Loop continues; iter-10 on landing. turbo, save ckpt+recon, params_M logged.
